problems.issue: Broken or placeholder image alt text on the main logo ('alt="http://deliadentalclinic.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/logo_2.png"').
problems.impact: Negatively impacts SEO, screen reader accessibility, and brand professionalism.

problems.issue: Empty or non-functional anchor links in the main navigation (e.g., href="#" for Introduce, Services, and Facilities).
problems.impact: Causes poor user experience, broken navigation flows, and potential bounce rate increases.

problems.issue: Inconsistent menu link types where some service items lack proper URLs (e.g., 'Invisalign braces' is plain text without an anchor link).
problems.impact: Limits user discovery of specific dental services and hinders deep-link SEO crawling.

opportunities: Implement comprehensive local schema markup (Dentist/MedicalBusiness) to improve local search visibility in Manila.
Add direct Call-to-Action conversion tracking on phone and WhatsApp header elements to better measure ROI from web traffic.
Optimize service sub-pages with dedicated conversion forms to capture patient appointment bookings directly from informational blog traffic.
audit.summary: Delia Dental Clinic's website establishes a foundational digital presence with essential contact info and service listings, but suffers from technical UX issues such as broken navigation links, missing image alt text, and incomplete menu routing that hinder both conversions and SEO performance.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on deliadentalclinic.com's navigation
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was just looking over your site for Delia Dental Clinic and noticed a few small navigation hiccups that might be frustrating for patients trying to find your services—like the main menu links for 'Introduce' and 'Services' currently leading nowhere, and Invisalign being plain text instead of a clickable page.

We put together a quick, live demo showing how fixing these routing gaps and cleaning up the logo alt text can make the site smoother for visitors and better for local search.

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---
If you'd prefer not to hear from me again, just reply 'unsubscribe' and I'll remove you right away.
